source: added-sources/Syllabus 10_1_2026.docx.pdf, PDF page 3 (weeks 6 to 9). It replaces the division in added-sources/Syllabus 9_3_26.pdf; weeks 1 to 5 and 10 to 14 are the same in both.
method: Each edit is [field, value under the September 3 syllabus, value under the October 1 syllabus]. src/features/sessions/civil-syllabus.js applies an edit only while the field still holds the September value, over the graph seed and over a saved copy alike, in the manner of the October 2026 audit corrections. namedCases and the wording of instructions follow the printed syllabus row. caseAccounts, concepts, availablePrintedPages and each entry's week tags are derived the way the September records were: an entry belongs to every week whose page spans overlap its own printed pages.

6: Subject-matter jurisdiction: diversity and federal questions

Lacks, Article III, Strawbridge, § 1332, Mas v. Perry, and A.F.A. Tours. Read the statutes identified in the chapter, especially §§ 1331, 1332, 1367, and 1441. Subject-matter jurisdiction recurs later in the course.

Lacks, Article III, Strawbridge, § 1332, Mas v. Perry, and A.F.A. Tours. Read the statutes identified in the chapter, especially §§ 1331, 1332, 1367, and 1441. Subject-matter jurisdiction recurs later in the course. Then federal-question jurisdiction and § 1331: Mottley, Eliscu, American Well Works, Shoshone, Smith, Grable, and Gunn. Eliscu is new in the October 1 syllabus, which gives the name alone and no page. A brief of T. B. Harms Co. v. Eliscu is on file; the case has no map entry yet.
7: Federal questions, supplemental jurisdiction, and removal

Federal-question jurisdiction and § 1331; Mottley, American Well Works, Shoshone, Smith, Grable, Gunn; Gibbs, Aldinger, Kroger, Finley, § 1367, Exxon; removal and § 1441, Shamrock Oil, Home Depot, Bright v. Bechtel, Lively v. Wild Oats, and Dart Cherokee.

The syllabus opens the week with § 1331, then Gibbs, Aldinger, Kroger, Finley, § 1367, Exxon; removal and § 1441, Shamrock Oil, Home Depot, Bright v. Bechtel, Lively v. Wild Oats, and Dart Cherokee. It then moves quickly through Chapter 5 and names Reasor-Hill, Bates, Livingston, Hoffman, and Piper Aircraft. Read §§ 1391, 1404, 1406, and 1407. Atlantic Marine and other chapter discussion remain available as context.
8: Venue, transfer, and forum non conveniens

The syllabus moves quickly through Chapter 5 and names Reasor-Hill, Bates, Livingston, Hoffman, and Piper Aircraft. Read §§ 1391, 1404, 1406, and 1407. Atlantic Marine and other chapter discussion remain available as context.

Continuing venue: the syllabus names no further venue reading, so the Chapter 5 cases named in week 7 stay listed here as context. Then Erie, with Swift and Black & White Taxicab as discussed in Erie.
